source.description: Broadcast Message Files: the edited message file that is played on Sunday
source.attribution: English source: Mariners Church weekend message. Personal project, not affiliated with Mariners Church.

automation.note: layer1: stop after the English table is approved. tracks: go on through translation, dubbing and the track reviews. publish: after the track reviews also prepare the page, ask for authorization on the publish page, make the two deployments, run the publish gate and ask for the device confirmation (rehearsed on the Dev site 2026-11-26 with last week's published page). A rehearsal never publishes. poster: after the page is live also draft, draw and compose the week's posters and ask on the poster page which one to upload (on since 2026-11-26, the user's decision after the upload ran on the Dev site).

transcription.basePrompt: Sermon from Mariners Church weekend service. Names and terms: Jesus, Mariners Church, Irvine, Tustin, North OC, Eric Geiger, Steve Bang Lee, John Thomas.
transcription.estimateNote: Reservation estimate only, not a bill. Reconcile the real spend with tools/ops/import_openai_costs.py.

sourceAutoStart.statement: 自动下载的来源授权，默认是周日的正式播放版，自动开始生产
sourceAutoStart.scope: Download a new file in source.folderId and start Layer 1 without asking. Covers this folder only.

paidTranscription.scope: Unattended OpenAI transcription for Layer 1, at most budget.weeklyCapUsd per ISO week. No other paid stage.

pageDecisions.statement: 页面上的提交算正式结论
pageDecisions.scope: A decision submitted on the tailnet review page is the formal human conclusion for the gate it names, bound to the hashes the page showed.

defaultApproveUnreviewed.statement: 批准表页面，加上批准按钮，不要求全部都审完，剩下的默认批准
defaultApproveUnreviewed.scope: English table page only: approving is one action, and sentences the reviewer did not hear or edit are approved by default. The receipt records how many were looked at.

syncRewrite.statement: 应当调用Opus口语化译文，达不到效果，再用Opus精简译文。
syncRewrite.scope: When a dubbed track cannot keep up with the video after silence trimming and per-sentence speed-up: Opus rewrites the lagging sentences colloquially, and only if that is not enough Opus condenses them. DeepSeek is not used for this.

autoPublish.statement: Dev 演练通过就开自动发布
autoPublish.scope: After the three track reviews the driver prepares the page and opens the publish authorization page. Nothing is deployed before the reviewer authorizes that publish intent there (pageDecisions); the authorization covers exactly the deployments the page lists. Covers the page, releases, catalogs, English reference and live-audio alignment. Does not cover the study guide entry, the statistics catalog, study content or posters.

posterUpload.scope: Approving one candidate on the poster review page is the instruction to upload that week's posters and announcement entries to the site. Nothing is uploaded before that approval, and nothing is sent to chat or email.
posterUpload.enabledBy: user (answer in the Claude session), 2026-11-26: 周六打开海报
